data.cultural_impact: The name Soraj, derived from the Hindu Sun God Surya, holds great cultural significance in Hindu mythology. Sun deity is frequently worshipped as the source of energy and life, represented as 'Prajapati' or the creator of all beings. The name carries the echoes of ancient rituals, traditions, and reverence towards the Sun.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Soraj lies in the connection it forms with the Sun God, Surya. This name is seen as an affirmation of the power of the divine Sun, from which all energy emanates. It is believed that the name resonates with the qualities of Surya, such as eternal light, strength, endurance, and warmth, helping the bearer to radiate inner joy and courage, thus leading to a path of enlightenment.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Soraj symbolizes the radiant and resplendent Sun, reflecting one's inner brightness, wisdom, and courage. It evokes the spirit of illumination and enlightenment, inspiring one to shine in the world like the celestial body.
